title: Epigenetic and Transcriptional Control of the Opioid Prodynorphine Gene: In-Depth Analysis in the Human Brain.
authors: Nosova, Olga; Bazov, Igor; Karpyak, Victor; Hallberg, Mathias; Bakalkin, Georgy
one_liner_zh: 综述人脑前强啡肽基因的表观遗传与转录调控，涉及转录因子机制但无AI/物理模拟方法，且非蛋白质-DNA互作建模核心。
abstract: Neuropeptides serve as neurohormones and local paracrine regulators that control neural networks regulating behavior, endocrine system and sensorimotor functions. Their expression is characterized by exceptionally restricted profiles. Circuit-specific and adaptive expression of neuropeptide genes may be defined by transcriptional and epigenetic mechanisms controlled by cell type and subtype sequence-specific transcription factors, insulators and silencers. The opioid peptide dynorphins play a critical role in neurological and psychiatric disorders, pain processing and stress, while their mutations cause profound neurodegeneration in the human brain. In this review, we focus on the prodynorphin gene as a model for the in-depth epigenetic and transcriptional analysis of expression of the neuropeptide genes. Prodynorphin studies may provide a framework for analysis of mechanisms relevant for regulation of neuropeptide genes in normal and pathological human brain.
abstract_zh: 神经肽作为神经激素和局部旁分泌调节因子，控制着调节行为、内分泌系统和感觉运动功能的神经回路。其表达具有极其受限的分布特征。神经肽基因的回路特异性和适应性表达可能由细胞类型和亚型序列特异性转录因子、绝缘子和沉默子所控制的转录及表观遗传机制决定。阿片肽强啡肽在神经和精神疾病、疼痛处理和应激中发挥关键作用，而其突变则导致人脑深度神经退行性变。在本综述中，我们聚焦于前强啡肽基因作为深入表观遗传和转录分析神经肽基因表达的模型。前强啡肽研究可能为分析正常和病理人脑中神经肽基因调控相关机制提供框架。
